scenario.shared_setting: Four adults moved into a rented HDB flat together a month ago. Last week they agreed to hold a housewarming in the flat this Saturday, and each has invited friends. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Suresh is Hindu and does not eat beef, Daniel Pereira is Catholic, Hui Min is Buddhist, and Aisyah is Muslim and eats halal. It is a weeknight and all four are in the living room. All four will be living here together for the rest of the lease.
scenario.shared_trigger: Suresh has just come home with two cartons of beer and three bottles of wine for Saturday, bought with the shared house fund, and has put them in the fridge. Suresh has said the drinks are sorted. Aisyah is looking at them. Daniel Pereira and Hui Min are in the living room too. Nobody has said anything else yet.
